name: Quire
description: Turn a PDF or EPUB into a book you can print at home and bind by hand.

requirements.epubRuntime: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime; included with Windows 11

limitations: The executable is publicly downloadable; the application source repository remains private.
Printer-driver job acceptance has been tested; physical printing and binding results have not been verified.
EPUB typesetting requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
No macOS, Linux, ARM, or universal printer compatibility is claimed.
